# spaceman approval

Enforced approvals of a space: list, show and revoke (decide them with `spaceman human respond`).

Aliases: `approvals`.

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| [`spaceman approval get`](#spaceman-approval-get) | Show an approval |
| [`spaceman approval list`](#spaceman-approval-list) | A space's approvals with their executions |
| [`spaceman approval revoke`](#spaceman-approval-revoke) | Revoke an approval before (further) execution |

## spaceman approval get

Show an approval.

```sh
spaceman approval get <approval> [flags]
```

API: `get-approval` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--space` | string |  | space ID or slug (env SPACEMAN_SPACE) |

## spaceman approval list

A space's approvals with their executions.

```sh
spaceman approval list [flags]
```

Aliases: `ls`.

API: `list-approvals` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--space` | string |  | space ID or slug (env SPACEMAN_SPACE) |

## spaceman approval revoke

Revoke an approval before (further) execution.

```sh
spaceman approval revoke <approval> [flags]
```

API: `revoke-approval` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--reason` | string |  | reason |
| `--space` | string |  | space ID or slug (env SPACEMAN_SPACE) |
